roleContext.jobDescription: The packaging plant runs six converting lines making cartons for food and drink customers. The Production Planner builds the weekly production schedule from the order book and the line capacities, resolves schedule conflicts with the shift managers, keeps the material call-offs aligned with the schedule, reports schedule adherence to the plant manager, and documents the schedule's open items. The planner has to hold their ground with shift managers when the schedule is challenged. Reports to the plant manager; works with the shift managers, the customer service team and the materials buyer.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Production Planner, Packaging Plant

## Experience

- Production planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines for four years, building each week's line schedule from the order book and the capacities of the six lines under the plant's scheduling procedure.
- Resolved the schedule conflicts raised by the three shift managers in the daily schedule meeting, with the conflict log recording each challenge, the resolution and the schedule adherence afterwards; adherence stayed above the plant target in fifteen of the sixteen quarters.
- Kept the material call-offs aligned with the schedule with the materials buyer through the weekly call-off review.
- Reported schedule adherence to the plant manager each week, recording in the report which schedule changes were mine and which were the plant manager's decisions.
- Wrote the open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next planning week at each weekly report.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one weekly production schedule, one month's conflict log with the adherence figures, one call-off review record and one weekly adherence report, with the planning system references as a verification trail.
